reasons: Both answers are close in content and cover every rubric item: the behavior is age-typical, fantasy is separated from blame-shifting, the interrogation and delayed punishment are rejected, and both suggest stating facts, repairing together and praising honesty. B more explicitly addresses the consistent approach both parents should follow, including why inconsistency teaches selective lying, and it cites the Talwar & Lee punitive-school finding more concretely while flagging uncertainty. A's husband script and one-month trial are good but slightly less direct on the need for a single shared approach, and it has a minor grammatical slip.
